text.p: These are the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs meeting of senior officials at the Military Industrialisation Commission.
- Foreign Ministry Undersecretary Riyad al-Qeisi meets Egyptian counterpart.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz receives Chinese delegation.
- Yemeni President Ali Abdullah Saleh receives Saddam's envoy and vows to throw his country's weight behind efforts to lift sanctions on Iraq.
- Iraq's national assembly stresses its backing of the Lebanese people in defending their land against Israeli occupation.
(The above were also carried by THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Article on Iraq's role in preserving security of Arab Gulf countries.
- Editorial blames the United States for delay in arrival of humanitarian supplies under oil-for-food deal with the United Nations.
- Commentary on a 1970 law granting Iraq's ethnic Kurds self-rule administration in their areas.
- Negotiations with French oil companies to develop oilfields in southern Iraq have reached an advanced stage.
- Spanish health delegation discusses Iraq's medical requirements.
- Article on reasons behind Israeli decision to build a new Jewish neighbourhood in Jerusalem.
